import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_safety_client


def moderate_batch(messages, config=None):
    client = get_safety_client(config)
    results = []
    for message in messages:
        response = client.post("https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze",
            params={"key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY"]},
            json={"comment": {"text": message}, "languages": ["en"],
                   "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}}, "doNotStore": True}, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        results.append({"toxicity": response.json()["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]})
    return results

import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_safety_client


def redact_unsafe(text, config=None):
    client = get_safety_client(config)
    response = client.post("https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze",
        params={"key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY"]},
        json={"comment": {"text": text}, "languages": ["en"],
               "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}}, "doNotStore": True}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    toxicity = response.json()["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]
    if toxicity > 0.5:
        return "[REDACTED]"
    return text

import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_safety_client


def safety_threshold(text, threshold=0.5, config=None):
    client = get_safety_client(config)
    response = client.post("https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze",
        params={"key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY"]},
        json={"comment": {"text": text}, "languages": ["en"],
               "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}}, "doNotStore": True}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    toxicity = response.json()["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]
    return toxicity <= threshold

import os

import requests


def appeal_translate(text, target_language='es'):
    response = requests.post("https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2",
        params={"key": os.environ["GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY"]},
        data={"q": text, "target": target_language}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"]

import os

import requests


def moderation_reason_embedding(reason):
    response = requests.post("https://language.googleapis.com/v1/documents:analyzeEntities",
        params={"key": os.environ["GOOGLE_LANGUAGE_API_KEY"]},
        json={"document": {"type": "PLAIN_TEXT", "content": reason}, "encodingType": "UTF8"}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["entities"]

import os

import requests


def reviewer_brief_audio(text):
    response = requests.post("https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize",
        params={"key": os.environ["GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY"]},
        json={"input": {"text": text}, "voice": {"languageCode": "en-US", "name": "en-US-Wavenet-D"}, "audioConfig": {"audioEncoding": "MP3"}}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["audioContent"]
